neighbours.label: the second half of a parallel coordination that repeats the first half's head noun ('the N of X and the N of Y'): fires on the repeated noun or its 'of'
fire: The safety of the miners and the safety of their families came first.
We compared the growth of cities and the growth of villages.
The voice of the young and the voice of the old should both be heard.
They debated the role of the church and the role of the state.
Training of nurses and training of doctors will be expanded.
Reports on the quality of water and the quality of air were released.
He wrote on the duties of kings and the duties of subjects.
The health of the soil and the health of the crops are linked.
quiet: The safety of the miners and their families came first.
We compared the growth of cities with that of villages.
The voices of young and old people should both be heard.
They debated how the church should relate to the state.
Training for nurses and doctors will be expanded next year.
Reports on water and air pollution were released today.
He wrote about kings, subjects and their duties.
Healthy soil helps the crops grow strong.

notes: card: ', and, The' after 'and' in parallel titles; probe: repeated 'X of A and X of B' reached 0.4-0.5, plain 'A and B' near 0
